summary: Proofs are otherwise robust (simp only + module/ring, no change/show, no long proofs, and the previously flagged hOdd step now goes through IsAlt.neg_eq). Two term-mode proofs in the new BilinMap.lean still typecheck only through undocumented definitional equality across wrappers.
